comment: All candidates shared low-rate momentum SGD, so architecture determined the ranking. B combined residual propagation with two LayerNorm blocks; D retained two LayerNorm blocks without skips. E's residual connections placed it above the one-LayerNorm shallow C, while A's unnormalized final block placed it last. K1020 and K1066 supported B's advantage, though their low-displacement and equal-LN evidence is conditional. K1059 most clearly supported C over A through final-block normalization. The gold agrees with these preferences but does not establish a universal additive LayerNorm-plus-residual score.
